svg.title: Sandemon's Lab build facility — tinkering
svg.desc: An animated build facility with no people in it. A reactor core powers 3 active machine bays, one per recently active repository, through cables whose energy flow follows GitHub activity. A monitor scrolls 185 days of contributions from 2026-03-24 to 2026-09-24 (total 144), and a build log cycles recent events. State: TINKERING, STABLE, EXPERIMENTING.

g.text: FOCUS THE LAB · 3/5 BAYS ONLINE · 1 REPOS 7D · 10 PR EVENTS 7D · IDEAS IN THE OVEN
